messages:
anya: Quick idea — can we add a ‘threshold onboarding’ step in the SLO editor that suggests defaults based on recent telemetry + per-route quotas? Would help reduce noisy configs from new teams.

mike: I like that. We could pull 30d p50/p95 latency + error rate and propose a percentile-based threshold. e.g. `suggested: {latency_p95: p95*1.2, error_rate: p99}`

lee: Be careful: tenants with bursty traffic will get bad suggestions. We need to include sample size & variance checks before recommending.

jordan: Agree with @lee. Also we need a clear UI affordance: "Suggested — apply" vs "Strict — enforce". Otherwise people will blindly accept and get paged. :grimacing:

sofia: For telemetry, can we show an inline sparkline and a small stat: "samples: 12k, unique_keys: 40" so reviewers can eyeball signal quality?

anya: Yes — show sample size + a confidence badge (green/yellow/red). If confidence low, disable the auto-suggest and show reasoning.

mike: API question: should suggestions be computed server-side in the config service or client-side from telemetry snapshot? Server-side seems necessary for consistency & audit logs.

lee: Server-side + cache. We should rate-limit suggestion calculations; otherwise it becomes a heavy query on metrics backend. Maybe compute suggestions asynchronously and cache per-route for 24h.

jordan: Rollout UX: when a team accepts a suggestion it should default to a canary: 5% of traffic for 1h, then escalate. Otherwise we risk widespread noise.

sofia: Also add a checkbox "Create notify-preview" which sends a single-channel test alert to the team's channel so they can verify noise before enabling real notifications.

anya: Nice. Also thinking about policy composition: suggested threshold + tenant overrides + global noise-suppressors. Need to ensure evaluation order is deterministic and visible in UI.

mike: Implementation note: we'll need a new API: `POST /suggestions/thresholds` that returns `{suggested_values, confidence, sample_stats, rationale}`. Keep it idempotent and cache-keyed by route + lookback params.

lee: One more: telemetry fidelity — when we compute suggestions, tag which metric streams were used (ingest id) so support can trace why a particular suggestion was offered.

jordan: Ops concern: if we enable auto-suggest widely, paging might drop in short-term but we could create complacency. Recommend soft rollout: console beta flag for existing PLG orgs only.

anya: Agreed. Plan: 1) API proto + cached job 2) UI mock for editor + preview channel option 3) small canary rollout with beta flag. I'll draft a short RFC.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: I scheduled a canary run for `suggestions-worker` on staging at 14:00 PT. See /deploys/4567 

sofia: Thanks — I'll sketch the mock and ping @anya and @jordan for review later today.

mike: I'll start the API scaffold. Leaving comments on the RFC once you drop it.

anya: Awesome — thanks team.
